title: TERNARY INTERCALATION COMPOUND OF GRAPHITE WITH ALUMINUM FLUORIDE AND FLUORINE
abstract: Abstract                Ternary intercalation compound of graphite with AlF3 and F2, CxF(AlF3)y was prepared under fluorine atmosphere at temperatures of 20–400 °C. Typical 1st stage compound has a composition of C6F(AlF3)0.15 with repeat distance 9.40 Å. Rapid progress in the reaction led to the formation of graphite fluoride, (C2F)n.
